beliefs: The first character is shifted backward by 2 in the alphabet (a->y, b->z, ..., z->x; A->Y, ..., Z->X) [E7, E8, E9, E10]
All characters after the first are left unchanged, including letters, digits, spaces, and symbols [E1, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8]
If the first character is not a letter (digit, space, symbol, control char, emoji), it is left unchanged [E1, E11, E12]

Non-ASCII letters are shifted backward by 2 in Unicode code point order, wrapping within the contiguous same-case letter block (é->ç, É->Ç, ü->ú, ñ->ï, ø->ö, æ->ä, œ->ő, ß->Ý, à->Þ, þ->ü) [E11, E12, E13, E14]

The shift for non-ASCII letters uses code-point arithmetic within the contiguous run of same-case letters containing the character, not alphabet position; ß (U+00DF) is treated as part of the lowercase run ending at ÿ, so ß->Ý wraps across the × boundary [E12, E13, E14]
The lowercase non-ASCII run starts at à (U+00E0), not at ß; à->Þ wraps backward past ß into the uppercase Þ [E14]
